newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Horton media buys South Auckland newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Horton media buys South Auckland newspaper.

text.p: Horton Media said it had purchased the Waiuku and Districts Post weekly newspaper for an undisclosed sum, the New Zealand Press Association reported on Friday.
Michael Horton, chairman of privately owned Horton Media, said the newspaper would be printed on the company's new Goss press which would be commissioned toward the end of this month.

Horton, the former managing director of listed publisher Wilson and Horton, has previously said Horton Media was looking at the feasibility of a South Auckland newspaper but that it was unlikely to be a daily.
The Waiuku and Districts Post newspaper was owned by John Draper who has joined the staff of the Business Herald launched recently by Wilson and Horton.
